exchanges: ok im in montreal!! my french is so bad the cab driver switched to english right away lol
That happens to everyone at first. It gets better fast.
i signed up for French classes at the ymca, starts next week
A great way to build confidence.
the job is at Montcalm, its a customs brokerage, i start monday
Customs work is detailed, but you have the head for it.
im gonna be a junior broker, so lots of paperwork for trucks crossing the border
Every shipment needs someone like you.
my roommate zainab is super nice, shes doing her masters at mcgill
Nice, what is she studying?
linguistics, she knows like 5 languages
That will help you with your French.
lol yes she corrects me constantly
A built-in tutor.
and the funniest part is my sister is also called zainab, my mom freaked out when i told her
Two of them in your life, easy to mix up.
my sister is in her second year of dentistry so shes always tired
That program is famously demanding.
my dad ravi keeps texting about the Roughriders game
Is he a big fan?
huge. we're from Saskatoon so its basically mandatory
Prairie football loyalty runs deep.
mathieu at work is all about the Canadiens tho, he has a flag on his desk
You might have to pick a side.
i bought a futon from a student moving out, carried it up 3 flights of stairs
The stairs here are legendary.
the outside spiral ones!! terrifying
Especially in winter.
found a yoga studio near me, going Friday evenings
A nice way to end the week.
my mentor yolanda at work took me for lunch today
That is a good sign of support.
shes Haitian and told me all the best griot places
Good to have local recommendations.
kenta from back home is moving to Vancouver soon, everyone is leaving saskatoon lol
The big cities are calling.
i actually used to go curling with him every winter
Maybe there is a club here too.
wait i messed up, the yoga is Saturday mornings not friday, friday was just the free trial
A morning class is a nice way to start the weekend.
also my favourite cafe so far is Olimpico, the lattes are insane
It is a well loved spot.
i might just live there
Plenty of people do.
zainab the roommate made us dinner tonight
Sweet of her. What did she make?
some lentil thing, it was amazing
Lentils done right are hard to beat.
my dad wants to visit in the fall
That will be nice, the city is beautiful then.
he wants to see a hockey game which is funny bc hes not even a hockey guy
Maybe the city will convert him.
mathieu said his sister Gabrielle works at the airport and can show me around the cargo side
A useful connection for someone in customs.
remind me what my roommate is studying
ok time to sleep, class early tomorrow
Good night.
